metric_definitions.change verdict: a verdict of abrupt change, persistent change or gradual drift, which the pipeline can raise a behavioural alert about
metric_definitions.deviating day: an evaluable day on which at least one feature's robust deviation reached the baseline's deviation threshold
metric_definitions.replicate range: the central share of replicates given by the configuration's confidence; not an interval for these homes
metric_definitions.silent day: a monitored day on which no sensor of the home reported an event

notes: Post hoc. Every description was chosen after the protocol's results had been read. None is part of the protocol.
A replay that leaves silent days out is a diagnosis of the run, not a corrected result.

The dataset holds sensor activations and no signal that a sensor or its gateway was working. A silent day may be an empty home or an apparatus that was not reporting; the data cannot say which. The dataset paper attributes a large drop in the activity data in mid-June 2019 to a technical failure in the data collection server.
The stationary and shuffled replays re-run the baseline alone. They count verdicts, not alerts: the alert policy is not replayed.

direction.event_count_z_is: the day's sensor event count against the household's previous monitored days, as the protocol's event-count reference computes it

reference_size.note: the Gaussian rate applies no floor to the scale, so it overstates a feature whose references sit at the floor

what_each_is.recorded: the baseline over each household's recorded feature values; it must give the run's own verdicts
what_each_is.shuffled: each household's recorded days in a random order, a day's features kept together, which keeps the values and what occurs on the same day and removes their order in time, weekly rhythm included
what_each_is.silent_days_skipped: the same, with every silent day left out of the history as an unobserved day is
what_each_is.stationary_gaussian: independent Gaussian values with each household's own median and MAD-based spread of each feature, on the same days

silent_days.definition: a monitored day on which no sensor of the home reported an event
